validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a"><onentry><send event="t"><content expr="1">literal</content></send></onentry><transition event="t" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<content>` declares more than one value source: `expr` and the child content
notes: `<content>` is either computed by `expr` or given literally as child content, never both
diagnostics.help: keep one value source: remove `expr`, or remove the child content
